Khalistan Row: India slams Canada on Kanishka Bombing Anniversary Amid Nijjar Row | Flashback
India has slammed Canada on the 39th anniversary of the Kanishka bombing which was orchestrated by Khalistani terrorists. The bombing in 1985 had killed 329 people, mostly Canadian citizens. Yet, the ideology that caused the bombing has found political patronage in Canada. Prime minister Justin Trudeau has courted Khalistani extremists and accused India of assassinating a designated Khalistani terrorist Hardeep Singh Nijjar. Catch the story of Kanishka bombing on Flashback with Palki Sharma.
